About SHI

SHI goes beyond manufacturing.

PT. Seo Heung Indoraya was established in March 2011 in Karawang — originally as PT. Seo Heung Trading Indonesia — to support the procurement of Chang Shin Indonesia, and today runs three lines: MRO distribution, chemical raw material supply, and installation & maintenance. It is part of Seoheung Co. Ltd (founded 2004) and the Changshin Group, operating across Korea, China, Vietnam and Indonesia under the SHC Indonesia brand.

Facility

Jakarta Customs backs domestic manufacturing with a Bonded Logistics Center licence for PT. Seo Heung Indoraya

26 November 2025 · DJBC Jakarta Regional Office

PT. Seo Heung Indoraya — a leading distributor of shoe materials, industrial machinery, spare parts, safety equipment and construction materials — officially received a Bonded Logistics Center (PLB) facility licence from the Jakarta Regional Office of Customs & Excise (Bea Cukai) on Monday, 24 November 2025.

A PLB lets companies store imported goods without paying import duty and taxes up front for a set period — improving logistics efficiency, supporting economic growth and local jobs around the facility, and reducing dwell time at ports. With this facility, PT. Seo Heung Indoraya can widen its customer network, raise logistics efficiency and productivity, and play a more strategic role in the national supply chain.

Conservation

Eco Laser cleaning demonstration & technical exchange at Borobudur Temple

21–22 May 2026 · Museum dan Cagar Budaya (Borobudur Unit) & Candi Borobudur

Together with ECO LASER Korea and Museum dan Cagar Budaya, PT. Seo Heung Indoraya took part in a Laser Cleaning Demonstration and Technical Exchange Program at Borobudur Temple — a UNESCO World Heritage Site — as part of a science- and technology-based conservation effort.

It is an honour for PT. Seo Heung Indoraya to demonstrate Eco Laser technology for the safe, effective and sustainable cleaning and care of one of Indonesia’s most valuable cultural heritage sites, and to support the development of conservation methods for cultural heritage in Indonesia.
